steps.question: Which color roles does it need?
steps.why: Each brand brings its own accent ramp.
Motion is shared, so one component library behaves the same in every brand.

steps.rule: The fill of the item the pointer or the keyboard is on, or whose submenu is open. A state shows on the item's background, one step from the surface it sits on: darker in light, lighter in dark.
steps.pick: neutral.100, two steps darker than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.0), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band without lifting off the page. It skips neutral.50, the page canvas, so a menu item never matches the page behind it.
steps.darkPick: neutral.100, one step lighter than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.50), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band on the menu and on cards.

steps.rule: Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.
steps.pick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.18:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.
steps.darkPick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.72:1, on surface.default). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.

steps.question: What rises above the page?
steps.why: Cards lift slightly to group offers.
The shadow shows a menu or dialog floats above the page. Without it, it blends into the cards.
Motion is shared, so one component library behaves the same in every brand.

steps.pick: neutral.50, under content: 1.05:1 from surface.default, so cards and panels stand forward.
steps.darkPick: neutral.0, under content: 1.13:1 from surface.default, so cards and panels stand forward.

steps.rule: Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.
steps.pick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.18:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.
steps.darkPick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.72:1, on surface.default). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.

steps.pick: shadow.overlay: a soft 32px blur at a 12px offset, four times the card's blur, so a menu or dialog floats clear above the cards.
steps.darkPick: shadow.overlay-dark: the same 32px blur and 12px offset in 50% black, so a menu or dialog still floats above cards on a dark page.

steps.question: Which text roles does it need?
steps.why: One set of roles across brands.
Prices sit in sentences and offers, not in columns to compare, so a mono font adds nothing in any brand.

steps.pick: neutral.600: the quietest text that still reads, 7.02:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.400: the quietest text that still reads, 6.97:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.pick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.85:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
